generation.explanation: The vertex form y = a(x − h)² + k makes transformations easy to read: h shifts the parabola left/right, k shifts it up/down, and a controls vertical stretch/compression and whether it opens up (a > 0) or down (a < 0). The vertex sits at the point (h, k). Use the sliders to change a, h, and k and watch the graph and vertex move in real time.
